source_caption:
12 months to plan. 12 hours to pull it off. 12 days to survive.🔥

Starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, 12 12 12 takes us into a high-stakes world of crime, deception and a daring bank heist beneath the streets of Zurich. Told across three gripping timelines, this is a game of cat and mouse where every move matters and trust comes at a price.

Three timelines. One audacious heist. And a whole lot to lose.
If you’re into edge-of-your-seat thrillers, this one’s calling your name!

Watch 12 12 12 now on @appletv.
